notes.title: Updates to key configurations and general operation.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing our game.
We are Mikosan Saho Team.

[b]The mouse and keyboard configuration has been updated and fixed.[/b]
The main modifications are as follows.

①Improved the convenience of key configurations.
②Added keyboard support for operation UI display.
③ Added support for some controllers.
④ Fixed the problem of key configuration not being saved.
⑤Fixed other minor bugs and changes.

Thank you for your continued support of "Touhou Mechanical Scrollery" in the future!

notes.title: Mouse and keyboard support and bug fixes updated.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing our game.
We are Mikosan Saho Team.

[b]Mouse and keyboard support and bug fixes have been updated.[/b]
The main modifications are as follows

① The mouse is now compatible with the operation. It is possible to include the mouse in the operation settings from the mouse and keyboard.
[u]The camera sensitivity can be adjusted from "Advanced Settings" after the key configuration.[/u]
② The camera operation can now be reversed. It is possible to adjust it from "Advanced Settings" after the key configuration.
③ The frame rate in full screen has been improved.
[u]However, if the resolution of the monitor is significantly higher, the frame rate may drop.[/u]
④ Fixed an issue where the screen could not be scrolled in the weapons store.
⑤ When the lock-on target is changed, it is changed so that the target can be selected from nearby enemies.
⑥ During combat, the map now shows the area where the quest target is located.
⑦ The possession limit of material items has been increased to 999. We also made it possible to send 10 at a time of sale.
⑧ Other minor corrections and changes were made.

If you find any new problems, please report them to us.
Thank you for your continued support of "Touhou Mechanical Scrollery" in the future!

notes.title: About the upcoming updates
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing our game.
We are Mikosan Saho Team.

After launch, we have received a number of reports of various problems with the game from users who have played it, and aim to fix those issues in order of urgency in the current situation.

① Full screen display causes significant low FPS.
->We will fix it to secure about the same FPS as the window mode.
②You can’t play the game with XboxONE controller. (Some XboxONE controllers do not work properly. )
-> We will fix it as soon as possible.
③ A bug that the cursor can not work when you are in the weapon shop depending on the screen resolution,
-> We will fix it to get it to work not depending on the resolution.
④ Adjustment of Lock-on target range
-> We will make adjustment to narrow the range for lock-on target so that you can lock on to the nearby enemies preferentially.
⑤ The phenomenon which mysterious darkness approaching
->This phenomenon does not appear for us in our environment… so, we would really appreciated it if you could provide us the detailed info on your envoironment as  PC configuration, version of DirectX, etc.  when you replicate this phoenomenon. It will help us to solve the issue more quickly!
⑥ Regarding mouse support and keyboard support
->We will do our best to support mouse such as mouse dragging.

We plan to work on a patch to fix those issues as above first. 
At this time we have not been able to grasp some issues yet, so we will start working on the one we can do for now, as soon as possible, separately. 

We will make further efforts in providing everyone with this game in the very best we can. 
Thank you for being patient with us as we prepare a fix.

notes.title: What you need to know when using the Xbox,PS4 controller
notes.notes:
If you are using an Xbox controller or PS4 controller, please go to "General Controller Settings" to set them respectively.
The procedure is...
① Select "Settings" from the "Steam" tab at the top left.
② Select "General Controller Settings" from "Controller".
③ Please check "PlayStation Configuration Support" for PS4 controllers and "Xbox Configuration Support" for Xbox controllers.

You can check the details from the following URL
https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/getting_started_for_players

Also, if you are unable to use the XboxONE controller, we are planning to fix the problem, so please be patient.

notes.title: We have made an update to enable operation by keyboard.
notes.notes:
P.S.: The tutorial was temporarily unavailable, so we immediately stopped publishing it and updated it to the corresponding version. We have now completed the correction. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you for playing our game.
We are Mikosan Saho Team.
[b]We have made an update to make it keyboard compatible.[/b]

When you want to use the keyboard, go to the Key Configuration from Setting without connecting any controller, and then assign each controller button to any key you like on the keyboard.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience we have caused to you.
We hope you will enjoy our game.

notes.title: Regarding Keyboard & Controller Issues
notes.notes:
Touhou Mechanical Scrollery is now on Steam! It's very exciting to finally get this new type of Touhou bullethell into everyone's hands. Our tiny team has been working very hard to be ready in time for the launch today, but we understand that we still have a lot more work to do! 

We're aware that some players are having problems with keyboards and controllers right now and we're working hard on a patch to fix those issues. As an indie team of die-hard Touhou fans, we want to provide everyone with the very best Touhou Mechanical Scrollery experience we can! Please be patient with us as we prepare a fix!

Thank you,
Mikosan Manners

notes.notes:
We are sorry for the inconvenience in regard to the keyboard allocation does not allow you to change the way you want.

For this issue we are working to fix this as soon as possible.

notes.title: Touhou Mechanical Scrollery　Available now!!
notes.notes:
Touhou Mechanical Scrollery flies onto Steam! This Touhou Project-inspired game by Mikosan Mannes combines airial 3D bullethells and hunting action games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222050/

Fly freely through the air as Reimu or Marisa and hunt down humongous foes while gracefully weaving through hundreds of 3D danmaku attacks! Touhou Mechanical Scrollery combines hunting action with bullethell for something completely new to the Touhou series!

notes.title: Release postponed
notes.notes: We're sorry for the short notice, but we've decided to postpone the release date of “Touhou Mechanical Scrollery | 幻想討幻経” from April 24th, 2020 to May 1st JST in order to put some final polish on the game before launch. We'd like to thank everyone for their understanding and patience! We're looking forward to welcoming everyone into this newest incarnation of the Gensokyo World!
